definitions.explanation: A place where two or more roads meet or cross.

examples.japanese: {交差点|こうさてん}で{事故|じこ}があった。
examples.english: There was an accident at the intersection.

examples.japanese: {交差点|こうさてん}を{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がってください。
examples.english: Please turn right at the intersection.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{交差点|こうさてん}を{左|ひだり}に{曲|ま}がってください。
examples.english: Please turn left at the next intersection.

notes:
{交差点|こうさてん} refers to where two or more roads cross. Essential for giving and understanding directions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {交差点|こうさてん}を{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がる: to turn right at the intersection
- {交差点|こうさてん}を{左|ひだり}に{曲|ま}がる: to turn left at the intersection
- {交差点|こうさてん}を{渡|わた}る: to cross the intersection
- {次|つぎ}の{交差点|こうさてん}: the next intersection

RELATED WORDS:
- {信号|しんごう}: traffic light
- {横断歩道|おうだんほどう}: pedestrian crossing
- {角|かど}: corner
